title: Life Plan Member Courtesy on Assisted Living Returned-Payment Charges
content:
**Life Plan member bulletin — returned payments under the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.**

A Larkspur Life Plan member receives a courtesy reduction on the returned-payment charge:

- a customer holding an **Entrance Fee Agreement** in occupied status with an **occupancy date at least 60 whole months** before the handling date pays **0.8** of the charge;
- a customer with an occupied Entrance Fee Agreement of **shorter standing** pays **0.9** of it;
- a customer **without** an occupied Entrance Fee Agreement has no courtesy reduction.

The courtesy share multiplies the charge before it is rounded once to the cent. Whole months run from the occupancy date to the handling date, a whole month being completed each time the count reaches the same day of the month as the occupancy date.

**Illustration (hypothetical charge of 60.00 before the courtesy).** Occupancy date 61 whole months back: 48.00. Occupancy date 59 whole months back: 54.00. No occupied agreement: 60.00.
